description: This file defines base classes for class-based views in a Flask web application, including View and MethodView, with methods for creating view functions and dispatching HTTP methods.

classes.name: View
classes.description: A base class for creating class-based views in Flask, allowing override of dispatch_request and conversion to view functions.

classes.name: MethodView
classes.description: A subclass of View that dispatches HTTP methods to corresponding instance methods, useful for REST APIs.

methods.name: dispatch_request
methods.description: Abstract method to be overridden by subclasses to handle requests.

methods.name: as_view
methods.description: Converts the class into a view function that can be registered with Flask routes.

methods.name: dispatch_request
methods.description: Handles dispatching of HTTP methods to class instance methods in MethodView.

methods.name: __init_subclass__
methods.description: Automatically sets the 'methods' attribute based on class methods and base classes in MethodView.
